shipped_rows.title_o: Emergence of enhanced attention to fearful faces between 5 and 7 months of age

blind_target.evidence_quote: In Study 1 ( n = 32), we replicated previous findings showing an asymmetrical pattern of categorization of happy and fearful faces in 6.5‐month‐old infants, and extended these findings by demonstrating that infants’ categorization did not differ when emotions were expressed by familiar (i.e., caregiver) faces.

blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract expressly states that this study replicated the prior finding; the original citation is not named in the available evidence.
